summary: Embassy Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing an expansion of its stock repurchase program by an additional $5 million, effective June 1, 2026. The original program, announced October 27, 2025, authorized up to $5 million; through Q1 2026, the company repurchased 258,301 shares for $4.856 million, leaving $144,000 unused. The expanded program allows open market or privately negotiated repurchases. Management expressed confidence in the company’s balance sheet and capital allocation. No premium, price per share, closing date, or advisor was disclosed. Watch for future repurchase pace disclosures in quarterly filings.
